description_en: Queries the attack event statistics information of a honeypot attack source
description_zh: 获取蜜罐攻击源的攻击事件统计信息
name: GetHoneypotAttackStatistics

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the attack source
parameters.name: src_ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of attack source statistics information. Valid values:

TOP_ATTACKED_AGENT: the top 5 probes by number of attacks.
TOP_ATTACKED_IP: the top 5 IP addresses by number of attacks.
ATTACK_EVENT_TYPE: the intrusion event type.
ATTACK_HONEYPOT_TYPE: the type of the compromised honeypot
parameters.help_zh:
攻击源统计信息的类型。取值：

TOP_ATTACKED_AGENT：被攻击次数top 5的探针。
TOP_ATTACKED_IP：被攻击次数top 5的IP地址。
ATTACK_EVENT_TYPE：入侵事件类型。
ATTACK_HONEYPOT_TYPE：被入侵蜜罐类型
parameters.name: statistics_type

parameters.help_en: The start time in timestamp format
parameters.name: start_time_stamp

parameters.help_en: The end time in timestamp format
parameters.name: end_time_stamp

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned by default. > Specify a value for the paging parameter
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，每页显示数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，pagesize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。>建议pagesize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page in a paged query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

StatisticsCount.description_en: The count of the statistics value

StatisticsType.description_en:
The type of attack source statistics information. Valid values:

TOP_ATTACKED_AGENT: the top 5 probes by number of attacks.
TOP_ATTACKED_IP: the top 5 IP addresses by number of attacks.
ATTACK_EVENT_TYPE: the intrusion event type.
ATTACK_HONEYPOT_TYPE: the type of the compromised honeypot
StatisticsType.description_zh:

HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 请求数据结果的HTTP状态码
